contests.title: Measure W
contests.summary: To improve the quality of education; construct, upgrade, and modernize classrooms, restrooms, and school facilities; make safety/security improvements; renovate or construct career technical education classrooms; replace leaky roofs; and renovate plumbing/sewer systems, shall Merced Union High School District's School Facilities Improvement District No. 1 measure authorizing $33,800,000 in bonds, at legal rates, and levying approximately $29 per $100,000 assessed value ($2,025,000 annually), while outstanding, be adopted, with annual audits, independent oversight, NO money for teacher/administrator salaries and all money spent locally?
contests.yes: Approve Measure W as described on the ballot.

links.label: Merced County official sample ballot BT001

contests.title: Measure T
contests.summary: The City of Livingston's City Clerk is an elected position. From and after November 2028, or upon earlier vacancy, the City Clerk shall be appointed by City Council, shall hold office at the pleasure of City Council, and, notwithstanding California Government Code 36502, is not required to be a City resident or elector. City Council may vest its appointive authority in the City Manager by Ordinance. Shall the office of the City Clerk be appointive?
contests.yes: Approve Measure T as described on the ballot.

links.label: Merced County official sample ballot BT001

contests.title: Measure U
contests.summary: The City of Livingston's City Treasurer is an elected position. From and after November 2028, or upon earlier vacancy, the City Treasurer shall be appointed by City Council, shall hold office at the pleasure of City Council, and, notwithstanding California Government Code 36502, is not required to be a City resident or elector. City Council may vest its appointive authority in the City Manager by Ordinance. Shall the office of the City Treasurer be appointive?
contests.yes: Approve Measure U as described on the ballot.

contests.title: Measure Z
contests.summary: To improve the quality of education; construct, upgrade, and modernize classrooms, restrooms, and school facilities; make safety/security improvements; renovate or construct career technical education classrooms; replace leaky roofs; and renovate plumbing/sewer systems, shall Merced Union High School District's School Facilities Improvement District No. 3 measure authorizing $129,000,000 in bonds, at legal rates, and levying approximately $29 per $100,000 assessed value ($7,825,000 annually), while outstanding, be adopted, with annual audits, independent oversight, NO money for teacher/administrator salaries and all money spent locally?
contests.yes: Approve Measure Z as described on the ballot.

links.label: Merced County official sample ballot BT006

contests.title: Measure B
contests.summary: CITY OF MERCED VITAL SERVICES PROTECTION MEASURE. Shall the measure to maintain local quality of life/general city services, such as 911 police/emergency medical/natural disaster response; responding quickly to neighborhood fires/retaining firefighters; youth services/gang prevention; addressing homelessness; fixing roads/potholes; and keeping parks safe/clean, by establishing a 1¢ sales tax, providing approximately $18,000,000 annually until ended by voters, with public disclosure, independent audits, citizen oversight, and all funds for Merced, be adopted?
contests.yes: Approve Measure B as described on the ballot.

links.label: Merced County official sample ballot BT006

contests.title: Measure X
contests.summary: To improve the quality of education; construct, upgrade, and modernize classrooms, restrooms, and school facilities; make safety/security improvements; renovate or construct career technical education classrooms; replace leaky roofs; and renovate plumbing/sewer systems, shall Merced Union High School District's School Facilities Improvement District No. 2 measure authorizing $59,100,000 in bonds, at legal rates, and levying approximately $29 per $100,000 assessed value ($3,505,000 annually), while outstanding, be adopted, with annual audits, independent oversight, NO money for teacher/administrator salaries and all money spent locally?
contests.yes: Approve Measure X as described on the ballot.

links.label: Merced County official sample ballot BT007

contests.title: Measure C
contests.summary: In order to repair/upgrade aging classrooms, science labs, career technology and school facilities to support college/career readiness in math, science, technology, arts, engineering, and skilled trades; fix deteriorating roofs, plumbing, HVAC, and electrical systems; and construct school facilities/classrooms to relieve overcrowding; shall Los Banos Unified School District’s measure authorizing $99,000,000 in bonds at legal rates be adopted, levying approximately $32/$100,000 assessed value ($5,000,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding, with independent audits/oversight and local control?
contests.yes: Approve Measure C as described on the ballot.

links.label: Merced County official sample ballot BT018

contests.title: Measure A
contests.summary: To improve the quality of education; modernize outdated classrooms, restrooms and school facilities; repair/replace leaky roofs; upgrade inadequate electrical systems; replace deteriorating plumbing systems; and make health and safety improvements; shall Le Grand Union High School District's measure authorizing $9,100,000 of bonds at legal rates be adopted, generating on average $672,300 annually while outstanding at annual rates of approximately $25 per $100,000 assessed value, with annual audits, independent citizens' oversight, NO money for salaries and all money staying local?
contests.yes: Approve Measure A as described on the ballot.
